newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance seen opening sharply lower. [CORRECTED 20:01 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance seen opening sharply lower. [CORRECTED 20:01 gmt]

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Friday shares of Mercury Finance Co were indicated at between $1-1/4 to $2-1/2, a fraction of their value before the company said it discovered bookkeeping problems that caused it to overstate earnings by $90 million.
Shares closed at 14-7/8 on Tuesday. (Corrects from "Wednesday") Trading was halted by the NYSE and it did not trade yesterday.
The shares had earlier been indicated at between $2 and $ a share each, the NYSE said.
